title: Vizmatic
description: Lit curves gather into the wordmark and let go again, as a seamless ten-second loop.

title: A drawing is a sum of circles
description: A real Fourier transform of an ampersand, redrawn by a chain of rotating arrows as the term count grows from 1 to 200.

title: A matrix moves the whole plane
description: A grid under one matrix: basis arrows, the determinant as area, and the two directions that stay on their lines.

title: The grid bends, its right angles survive
description: A grid unfolds under z squared and curls into a disk under a Mobius map, with the angle at every crossing measured live.

title: One point, two shadows
description: A point sweeps the unit circle, sine and cosine trace themselves, and the formula collapses into Euler's identity.

title: Downhill, one step at a time
description: Real gradient descent on a two-basin loss surface: two starts 0.12 apart travel together, then finish in different minima.

title: Attention, computed
description: Queries, keys, and values produce a live heatmap as softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d)) V builds up term by term.

title: The rules are exact, the future is not
description: The Lorenz system integrated with real numbers: two starts a hair apart part ways, then 72 fill the butterfly.

title: Twelve coin flips, nine hundred times
description: A Galton board settles into a histogram that meets the Gaussian curve, with mean and deviation measured from the balls.

title: Move the pieces, keep the square
description: A proof by rearrangement: four triangles slide inside a square, and the leftover area writes the theorem.

title: Sine, from what it does at zero
description: Polynomials hug the sine curve further out as each term grows in, with the trusted range measured live.

title: One key expires
description: A dense service diagram comes alive: a hot key expires at 12,000 requests per second, and a simulated stampede hits Postgres.

title: Why we rebuilt the renderer
description: A six-chapter talk that plays in stepped mode, with a live timeline and measured results.
